Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested in human assays against the target CHEMBL1293277. Join molecule_dictionary to activities on molregno, join activities to assays on assay_id, and join assays to target_dictionary on tid. Filter by target chembl_id CHEMBL1293277 and assay organism Homo sapiens. Require canonical_smiles via an inner join to compound_structures. Sort by compound ChEMBL identifier.
